body.statement: For a finite rational coefficient encoding \(D\in\mathbb Q[S3]\), the procedure \(\mathcal A_D\) terminates and accepts exactly when \(D\in\mathcal D_{\mathrm{SN},3}\). It rejects before forming \(J_D\) whenever \(D(I3)=0\). On acceptance, the ordered eigenvalues of \(J_D\) are \(a+b+e,b+e,e\), and \(CertD\) contains rational bases for the active spaces, the exponents, \(\lambda_0\), \(c\), and a zero coefficient residual. On rejection, \(CertD\) contains an exact failed guard, a forced nonpositive constant, or a nonzero residual coefficient. No bit-complexity bound is claimed.
body.justification: The finite exact-input contract turns the classification into an auditable recognition and flag-recovery certificate.
body.gap: Tamano's factor-and-rank diagnostic is inconclusive for determinant-free irreducible factors of degree at least three; exact-algebra sources supply operations but no self-normalization classifier.
body.consumer: A symbolic half-trek pipeline can certify the denominator class without altering the primitive reduced fraction.
body.proof_tex:
All initial operations in \(\mathcal A_D\) are finite exact operations on rational coefficient arrays.  After the zero, constant, and homogeneity guards, put
\[
 T=2\operatorname{tr}\{(G_DX)^2\},
 \qquad
 R=D^2.
\]
Choose a monomial whose coefficient \(p\) in \(R\) is nonzero, and let \(t\) be its coefficient in \(T\).  If \(T=cR\) for any scalar \(c\), coefficient comparison forces \(c=c_0=t/p\).  Hence \(c_0\leq0\) is an exact rejection witness, while for \(c_0>0\) any nonzero coefficient of \(T-c_0R\) is an exact rejection witness.  If the residual is zero, the guarded polynomial belongs to \(\mathcal D_{\mathrm{SN},3}\), and the complete classification applies.

For a classified polynomial every compression determinant is positive at \(I3\), so \(D(I3)\neq0\); thus the identity test can never lead a member to fail the next guard.  Conversely, if the guard \(D(I3)=0\) fires, the classification shows that the input cannot be a member.  It is therefore safe to form the rational symmetric matrix
\[
 J_D=\frac{G_D(I3)}{D(I3)}.
\]
For any full-row-rank basis matrix \(B\), differentiation at \(I3\) gives
\[
 G_{\log\det(BXB^{\top})}(I3)
 =B^{\top}(BB^{\top})^{-1}B=\Pi_{\operatorname{row}(B)}, \tag{11}
\]
the orthogonal projection onto its row space.  Therefore a flag form satisfies
\[
 J_D=a\Pi_{V1}+b\Pi_{V2}+eI_3. \tag{12}
\]
Nested orthogonal projections commute.  On the orthogonal decomposition
\[
 \mathbb R^3=V1\oplus(V2\cap V1^{\perp})\oplus V2^{\perp},
\]
equation (12) has the ordered eigenvalues
\[
 \lambda_1=a+b+e,
 \qquad
 \lambda_2=b+e,
 \qquad
 \lambda_3=e. \tag{13}
\]
Consequently the recognizer recovers
\[
 a=\lambda_1-\lambda_2,
 \qquad
 b=\lambda_2-\lambda_3,
 \qquad
 e=\lambda_3. \tag{14}
\]
These numbers are nonnegative integers on every accepted input.  Because \(J_D\) is rational and the eigenvalues in (13) are integers, the relevant eigenspaces are rational nullspaces.  Exact Gaussian elimination therefore returns rational bases for every active space.  If \(a=0\), a rational line may be chosen inside the recovered plane; if \(b=0\), a rational plane may be chosen containing the recovered line; if \(a=b=0\), any rational complete flag may be chosen.  These choices affect only inactive flag entries.

For the recovered rational bases define
\[
 \lambda_0=
 \frac{D(I3)}{\Delta_1(I3)^a\Delta_2(I3)^b},
\]
where \(\delta(I3)^e=1\).  This is a nonzero rational number.  Exact expansion of \(D-D_{\mathrm{flag}}\) verifies every coefficient.  The classification and the active-space uniqueness just proved show that this residual is zero for every member.  Conversely, a zero residual directly verifies the flag form and hence, by flag sufficiency, membership; thus no false acceptance is possible.  Formula (10) gives
\[
 c=2\bigl(\lambda_1^2+\lambda_2^2+\lambda_3^2\bigr).
\]
Every branch of the procedure consists of differentiation, arithmetic on finitely many rational coefficients, factorization of a cubic characteristic polynomial, rational nullspace computation, and finite coefficient comparison.  Hence it terminates.  The failed guard or coefficient, or else the data in (13)--(14), the rational bases, \(\lambda_0\), \(c\), and the zero residual, is exactly the asserted certificate.  No estimate of bit complexity was used.
